metadata.description: Claude Code mods for Ryan, Connor and Manav. Five vetted from their authors (pinned copies, see each PROVENANCE.md) and four written here.

plugins.name: token-weather
plugins.description: Context-window forecast above the prompt (Anthropic sample; patched to stack with other bands)

plugins.name: flightdeck
plugins.description: Read-only side pane: context, cost, permissions, subagents (Stephen Casella)

plugins.name: blast-radius
plugins.description: Holds rm -r, force-push, git reset and shows what they'd hit (Anthropic sample)

plugins.name: replay-theater
plugins.description: /replay steps through the last turn's file edits (Anthropic sample)

plugins.name: model-router
plugins.description: Lookup subagents to Haiku, general subagents to Sonnet; /router

plugins.name: live-activity
plugins.description: Tool and subagent counts in the spinner; last-turn summary

plugins.name: next-steps
plugins.description: Three suggested follow-ups as buttons after each answer; /nextsteps

plugins.name: done-alert
plugins.description: Notification + chime when a long turn ends or Claude needs you; /alerts
